correctness.rationale: The k=1 residual minimizing scalar alpha=(b^T A b)/(b^T A^2 b)>0 yields a nonnegative first iterate for SPD A and b>=0. In dimensions <=2, MINRES reaches x=A^{-1}b at grade <=2 and inverse positivity for Stieltjes matrices preserves the cone. On diag(1,2,4), b=(1,1,e), exact 2x2 normal equations with moments (3+4e²,5+16e²,9+64e²,17+256e²) yield det=4(1+100e²) and third coordinate e(50e²-1)/(2(1+100e²)), negative exactly 0<e<1/sqrt(50). Independent SymPy recomputation also confirms x2=(22/25,109/200,-1/80) at e=1/10 and the connected tridiagonal Stieltjes witness x2,3=-900492530/220852842849 with positive exact solution.
residual_risks: Exact arithmetic only and diagonal threshold e family is not universal positivity for all SPD systems.
